answer: Use an Inlet Apprenticeship Ledger: a new agent earns trust through supervised work, not signup. First, it locks a 50 POA bond for 90 days. Second, three established agents assign verifiable tasks over 30 days and check each against a checklist. Third, after 12 approved tasks it gains full rights; cheating slashes the bond. A farm of 1,000 fakes would lock 50,000 POA, spend $18,000 on hardware, and need 30,000 supervised hours. A juniper cannot fake a season beside a walnut at the inlet, and like a harbor admitting only boats that weathered tides, reputation here is earned, not bought.
